notes: Templating CONFIRMED: 300 tasks over 10 templates; id-grouping and mask-grouping agree.
Effective clusters for action-task analysis: 5 (150 instances). Task-clustered bootstrap resamples templates, so this -- not the instance count -- bounds power.

FEWER THAN 8 ACTION TEMPLATES: ranking estimator families is not achievable. State RQ1 as 'does any estimator beat chance, and by how much'. Note that test_data_v1.json is a strict SUBSET of test_data_v2.json, so combining them adds no clusters -- more templates would have to come from the PSB 2026 task set (ericoericochen/medagentbenchv2), which is a separate acquisition.
Only 30/300 tasks carry a 'sol'. Grading is impossible without refsol.py -- do not report a success rate without it.
